Synopsis:
You helped two tieflings kill a strange creature. (Lae'zel.) You talk to them, and they tell you about a blast they heard. (The ship crash.)

Cluster Contexts:
- CHA_LaeZelRecruitment_LaezelDead.json: You're standing in the aftermath of a fight where you helped two tieflings (likely Damays and Nymessa) deal with a strange, defiant githyanki who had been caged — Lae'zel — whom they had hoped to bind and haul back to their grove. The tieflings are grateful and now mention a loud blast that shook their camp, an off‑screen event that corresponds to the ship crash. They plan to go investigate that disturbance, so you can either press them for details or let them leave. The exchange likely takes place near the tiefling den/grove and other companions (for example Shadowheart) may be present or have already warned you about Lae'zel.
- CHA_LaeZelRecruitment_AD_LaeZelDead.json: Two tieflings that faced a strange creature (Lae'zel) comment that it is finally dead after battle.
- CHA_LaezelRecruitment_AD_LeavingAnyCombat2.json: |Tieflings joined a random combat and were dragged far from Lae'zel Recruitment. They will leave out of stage while saying this instead of going back to the scene.|
- CHA_LaezelRecruitment_TieflingsSceneFallback.json: Edge-case: the normal dialog failed to start. Someone is silenced or wild shaped... Let's just do the midmeld and start combatYou come upon Lae'zel, an alien-looking githyanki trapped in a cage, with two tieflings deciding her fate. Damays thinks its best to take it back to camp to keep an eye on. Nymessa wants to just leave it alone. If Shadowheart is present, she'll warn the player to not trust Lae'zel (she doesn't trust gith due to previous experiences while on a secret mission against them, but doesn't elaborate).
- CHA_LaeZelRecruitment_TieflingsScene.json: The party finds an alien-looking githyanki (Lae'zel) trapped in a cage in the Emerald Grove shortly after the attack on the Den was resolved — celebrations are underway and Halsin has already returned, postponing any tadpole discussion until morning. Two tieflings (Damays and Nymessa) are arguing over what to do: Damays favors taking Lae'zel back to camp to keep an eye on her, while Nymessa wants to leave the prisoner be. Lae'zel communicates telepathically, ordering the party to "get rid" of nearby NPCs, which explains her silent, lip‑still lines. The player can respond by ordering the tieflings to leave, attempting to free or neutralize the prisoner (shoot the trap), or otherwise intervene; if Shadowheart is present she will warn the player not to trust Lae'zel based on prior secret missions against githyanki.

- Nymessa: Th-thank you. I couldn't have done it without you. (node 3)
- Nymessa: But I've got to go. I need to check out that blast. (node 15)
- Player: A blast? Care to be more specific? (node 11)
- Nymessa: You didn't hear it? Shook our camp good, so I came for a look. (node 24)

context: You are standing in the aftermath of a fight where you and two tieflings (Damays and Nymessa) dealt with a strange, defiant githyanki — Lae'zel — who had been caged. The tieflings are grateful and tell you they heard a loud blast that shook their camp (an off‑screen event that corresponds to a nearby ship crash) and now want to go investigate. This exchange happens near the tiefling den/Embered Grove while other companions (for example Shadowheart) may be present or have already warned you about Lae'zel. You can press them for more details about the blast or let them leave to look into it.
